title: Finite-coherence signal memory
hypothesis:
Damped local trend can anticipate a slowly evolving recorded RSRP channel; its learned coefficient tests extrapolation against persistence.

Development feedback available before this hypothesis: No earlier attempt; fixed baselines available.

This attempt tests a distinct explanation/ablation. All reserved groups remain unscored. A failure to beat the incumbent rejects predictive benefit rather than proving absence of the underlying physical process.
equation: offset(input) + scale(input) * sum_j coef[j] * named_basis[j](input); all named bases defined in run.py; optional correction clipping/nonnegative output explicitly in state.
